probe: filmed by hand: the step window shows and says each step and waits for you (say next / go / done, or Right Shift + 9); the clip ends after the last one. No game sound in the video: the spoken steps come out of the speakers the recorder listens to
steps: vsShot ui dur=0 max=900 hand=1 help=0
title: Banana Regrow
kicker: Farming Simulator 25 mod: a whole banana plantation in one click

hand.do: Go to your banana plantation, carrying the machete
hand.why: Ripe plants if you have them. Walking there is not in the video.

caption.heading: Your plantation
caption.text: Ripe bananas, and plants waiting to be cut back.

hand.do: Click one corner, then the opposite corner
hand.why: Yellow markers: ripe. Green: to cut back.

caption.heading: Mark the area
caption.text: Ripe plants get yellow markers, plants to cut back green ones.

hand.do: Click again to harvest and cut back

caption.heading: One click
caption.text: Every ripe plant harvested, every plant cut back.

hand.do: Read the result, then look at the plants

caption.heading: Straight to the washing station
caption.text: The bananas go to your nearest washing station; the plants regrow from next month.

hand.do: Press ESC to leave the construction menu
